title: AlertPayload
description: Webhook alert payload sent by TxWatch when a rule fires

schema_version.description: Schema version for this payload shape. Additive changes (new optional fields) keep the same version; breaking changes (field removals or renames) bump it.

alert_id.description: Stable, deterministic alert identifier derived from (network, contract_id, tx hash, rule_type, rule params) via SHA-256 (32 hex chars). Receivers should deduplicate on this value.

label.description: Human-readable contract label from the config.

contract_id.description: Soroban contract address (56-character string starting with 'C').

rule_type.description: Stable machine-readable rule variant (e.g. 'LargeTransfer', 'HighFee'). Use this for programmatic routing.

rule_triggered.description: Human-readable rule description with parameters (e.g. 'LargeTransfer(>=10000XLM)'). Use this for display.

function_name.description: The first invoked Soroban function name, or null for non-Soroban transactions.

function_names.description: All invoked Soroban function names in the transaction (may contain multiple entries for multi-op transactions).

amount_xlm.description: Transfer amount in whole XLM (truncated integer). Kept for backward compatibility — use amount_xlm_decimal for precise accounting.

amount_stroops.description: Raw transfer amount in stroops (1 XLM = 10,000,000 stroops).

amount_xlm_decimal.description: Transfer amount as a decimal string with 7 fractional digits (e.g. '9999.9900000'). Use this instead of amount_xlm when precision matters.

fee_charged_stroops.description: Fee charged for the transaction in stroops.

source_account.description: The G-address that submitted the transaction. Omitted from the payload when not present on the Horizon record.

severity.description: The severity level set on the matching rule. Omitted when not configured.

horizon_link.description: Direct Horizon REST API URL for the transaction. Useful for fetching raw XDR or operation details programmatically.

explorer_link.description: Stellar Expert web explorer URL for the transaction. Useful for human-readable inspection in a browser.

ledger.description: Ledger sequence number in which this transaction was included.

operation_count.description: Total number of operations in the transaction.

resolved.description: true for a recovery alert (e.g. activity resumed after NoActivity). false (the default) for an incident alert.

matched_events.description: For EventEmitted alerts, the matching contract events; empty for other rule types.

suppressed_count.description: Number of matches of this rule suppressed by its cooldown_seconds since the previous alert was sent. 0 when the rule has no cooldown or nothing was suppressed.

test.description: true only for synthetic payloads sent by 'txwatch test-webhook'; omitted from the JSON otherwise.

enrichment_incomplete.description: true when the transaction's operations could not be fetched, so function_names / amount_stroops may be incomplete. Omitted from the JSON when false.

ContractEvent.description: A Soroban contract event emitted by a transaction, as returned by Soroban RPC getEvents.

topics.description: ScVal topics in their JSON form (e.g. {"symbol": "transfer"}).
